About Valley Shore Community Television

Valley Shore Community Television is a local non-profit organization responsible for providing public, educational, and government access to the towns of nine town Clinton cable franchise area. Our Public Access studio is located at 1587 Boston Post Road in Westbrook, CT and is open to the public. We're always looking for more volunteers!
